card.line: Mount Zemaraim was a mountain in the hill country of Ephraim, where King Abijah of Judah spoke to Jeroboam and Israel before their great battle.

moments.title: Abijah speaks from the mountain
moments.text: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim and called out to Jeroboam and all Israel. He reminded them that the LORD gave the kingship to David's descendants, and that Jeroboam had rebelled and made golden calves. He said Judah had not forsaken the LORD.
